task: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First thing I need you to do is to attempt to go to the north. Then, travel east. If you can manage that, go south. After that, make an effort to go to the south. If you can get around to doing that, try to take a trip south. Once you succeed at that, go to the west. With that accomplished, venture north. And then, try to go to the west. Once you do that, take a trip south. With that done, travel west. After that, travel south. Then, move east. After that, make an attempt to travel north. Next, head east. After that, head south. And then, travel east. Once you accomplish that, go to the east. Then, make an attempt to travel north. Then, make an effort to go to the north. After that, try to move east. And then, venture south. And then, make an effort to take a trip south. Then, venture west. Then, take a trip north. Then, make an attempt to take a trip east. Following that, venture east. After that, move north. That done, make an effort to travel east. Following that, venture south. With that done, head south. Once you manage that, move west. And then, attempt to travel west. And then, take a trip west. After that, make an effort to take a trip west. That done, venture north. Then, attempt to move north. Then, attempt to head north. Okay, and then, travel west. Next, go west. Then, attempt to take a trip north. With that over with, go east. And then, head south. Once you accomplish that, try to take a trip south. And then, pick up the coin from the floor of the absurdly hot kitchen. And once you've done that, you win!
